mine.title: Keep this dashboard honest
mine.next: Regenerated 2026-07-25 17:30 UTC from the project files, log.md and live gh data; the previous generation was 24 hours old and said there were no closed issues anywhere, which stopped being true at 15:14 UTC. Three standing rules: never bake a relative date into a static file, state wall-clock ages instead; check a public surface the way a reader receives it, because an artifact can fail silently by growing; and put the next decay date on a freshness surface, not just the regeneration date — this dashboard's is tonight at 22:17 UTC
